alarms.message: Upper reservoir below safe operating level

interlocks.description: Contamination inlet may only open while the badwater diversion is confirmed open
Spillway may not open past 1.5 m while the upper reservoir is below 1.5 m

modes.label: Normal Operations
modes.description: Gates follow standard automation; standard alert thresholds.

modes.label: Drought Preparation
modes.description: Fill priority reservoirs, restrict nonessential outflow.

modes.label: Drought Emergency
modes.description: Close discretionary releases; preserve drinking water.

modes.label: Badtide Isolation
modes.description: Clean-water intakes closed, diversion routes open.

modes.label: Reservoir Recovery
modes.description: Controlled refill; irrigation limited until safe depth is restored.

modes.label: Manual Engineering
modes.description: Automation suspended; every command logged; hold-to-confirm on high-risk controls.
